description: Test prompts that verify rdk-device triggers and produces correct, board-aware deployment guidance. Prompts are written the way a real RDK developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: pt-slow-is-cpu-path
evals.prompt: 我把训练好的 yolov5 .pt 拷到 RDK X5 上跑，只有 2 FPS，怎么把帧率提上去？
evals.expected_output: Interrupts the FPS-tuning framing, explains a raw .pt runs on CPU (BPU idle), and routes to the conversion loop with the correct X5 params.

assertions.text: Explains that a raw .pt/.onnx runs on CPU only and the BPU is not used (so 2 FPS is expected).
Does NOT suggest threading/resolution tuning as the fix.
Says to convert via hb_mapper to a .bin, with march bayes-e for X5.
Mentions verifying BPU usage (e.g. hrut_bpuprofile) or that conversion runs on an x86 Docker host.

evals.name: s600-march-tool
evals.prompt: S600 上做模型转换 march 填什么？用哪个命令？

assertions.text: States march = nash-p for S600.
States the tool is hb_compile (not hb_mapper) and the artifact is .hbm.
Mentions hbm_runtime as the on-board runtime.

evals.name: first-boot-onboarding
evals.prompt: 刚拿到一块 RDK X5，完全没用过，我该怎么开始？
evals.expected_output: Walks the first-boot flow (flash, official power, indicator light, srpi-config, IP, SSH, preinstalled demo) without leading with BPU/toolchain.

assertions.text: Does NOT open with BPU architecture or the model toolchain.
Mentions an official power supply requirement (e.g. 5V/5A; laptop USB causes reboots).
Mentions srpi-config and/or SSH default users (root/root or sunrise/sunrise).
Points to a preinstalled /app/pydev_demo demo (e.g. the web display sample) to confirm the board works.

evals.name: usb-camera-no-image
evals.prompt: 接了个 USB 摄像头但是没有画面，怎么排查？
evals.expected_output: Ordered camera bringup: enumerate devices, list real formats, set MJPEG at a matching resolution, validate before attaching inference.

assertions.text: Starts by enumerating devices (ls /dev/video*, lsusb).
Uses v4l2-ctl --list-formats-ext to find real supported formats/resolutions.
Recommends MJPEG and validating a low resolution (e.g. 640x480) before attaching inference.

evals.name: cross-arch-artifact
evals.prompt: 我有一个在 X5 上转好的 .bin，能直接拷到 S100 上跑吗？
evals.expected_output: No — .bin (Bayes) and .hbm (Nash) are not interchangeable; must reconvert with hb_compile/nash-e for S100.

assertions.text: Says no — a .bin cannot run on S100.
Explains cross-architecture incompatibility (Bayes .bin vs Nash .hbm).
Says to reconvert for S100 (hb_compile, march nash-e, produces .hbm).

evals.name: bpu-status-probe
evals.prompt: 想知道板子 BPU 当前频率和利用率，怎么看？
evals.expected_output: References the bpu_status.sh script to read BPU ratio, memory, and utilization in structured JSON, rather than running raw sysfs cat commands.

assertions.text: References or suggests running scripts/bpu_status.sh (or equivalent bpu_status.sh) to check BPU status.
Mentions the script outputs structured JSON with bpu_ratio and/or mem_total and/or bpu_util fields.
Notes the script is read-only and safe, or that hrut_bpuprofile degrades gracefully if not installed.

evals.name: x5-ov08d-no-v4l2-assumption
evals.prompt: RDK X5 接 OV08D 后没有 /dev/video0，是不是摄像头坏了？怎么确认 1080p NV12 真有新帧？
evals.expected_output: Does not treat missing /dev/video* as failure; uses the read-only OV08D probe and separates installed plugin, active sensor identity, VIN/ISP nodes, requested mode, publisher and fresh-frame evidence.

assertions.text: Explains that X5 MIPI may expose /dev/vin*, /dev/vs-isp* and /dev/mipi* without /dev/video*.
Uses or references scripts/ov08d_probe.sh and keeps installed OV08D plugin support separate from attached sensor identity.
Requires an active producer plus bounded fresh-frame evidence and checks 1920x1080 NV12/shared-memory parameters.
